name: claude-quota
description: Show Claude Code (claude.ai subscription) quota usage in the VS Code status bar.

claudeQuota.credentialsPath.markdownDescription: Path to Claude Code's credentials JSON. Defaults to `~/.claude/.credentials.json`. On macOS Claude Code stores credentials in the Keychain, which this extension cannot read.

claudeQuota.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh Claude quota data (seconds, minimum 15).

redBelowPercent.markdownDescription: Remaining percentage below which the status bar shows the red warning background. Checked first.

amberBelowPercent.markdownDescription: Remaining percentage below which the status bar shows the amber warning background (and at or above which it shows green text).

claudeQuota.thresholds.markdownDescription: Color-band thresholds in percent of quota _remaining_. Example: `{ "redBelowPercent": 5, "amberBelowPercent": 50 }`

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Requires trusted local credentials or executable access.
